site.title: SmartOut - The future of workforce management
site.description: AI-powered workforce management for the hospitality industry.
hero.badge: AI does the work for thousands. Why not you?
hero.subtitle: While others fill out spreadsheets manually, Smartout users experience an operating system in motion. The foundation is completely free. AI takes over the routine tasks.
steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: From zero to AI-powered operations in under a week. Smartout isn't just software — it's an unstoppable force moving forward.
steps.1.title: A rock-solid foundation
steps.1.desc: Start with the industry's best free version. Scheduling, time tracking, absence management, and team communication. No licenses. Only possibilities.
steps.2.title: Gather your team
steps.2.desc: Invite your team into the app. Set up routines, sign contracts digitally with BankID, and run full onboarding before the first shift.
steps.3.title: Let AI take over
steps.3.desc: Switch on Premium when you need speed. Lise Botsson answers on chat, and the Event Engine auto-builds shifts based on learning and history.
website.label: Included in Free
website.title: A website that breathes.
website.desc: Smartout Website Factory generates a professional, razor-sharp website for your business — automatically. No coding. Always up to date with opening hours, menus, and table reservations, directly connected to your data in Smartout.
website.mockup.name: Café Belle
website.mockup.tagline: French inspiration in the heart of the city.
hms.label: Full control
hms.title: Ditch the HMS binder.
hms.desc: Food safety and internal controls are no longer dusty ring binders. Smartout digitizes temperature checks, deviations, and cleaning — and reminds staff to complete tasks on time. When the Food Safety Authority knocks, documentation is always 100% ready.
hms.feature.1: Automatic push alerts for temperature logs
hms.feature.2: Easy deviation logging with mobile camera
hms.mockup.title: Daily Food Safety
onboarding.label: Cascade Onboarding
onboarding.title: Continuous certification.
onboarding.desc: Forget the superficial "Read and understood". Smartout uses our "Cascade" architecture to ensure staff are actually qualified. An employee is only marked "Ready" when all policies are reviewed and knowledge is verified with signature and test.
onboarding.feature.1: Seamless progression from Policy to Protocol
onboarding.feature.3: Mutual signing on contracts and terms
onboarding.mockup.name: Martin Johansen
onboarding.mockup.step.1.title: Handbook
onboarding.mockup.step.2.title: Safety & Routines
onboarding.mockup.step.3.title: Alcohol laws test
seasons.label: Dynamic Operations
seasons.title: Summer vs. Christmas party.
seasons.desc: Our Cascade architecture lets you change the operating model with one click. Switch from a quiet winter season to a hectic summer. Budget, day factors, and hour factors scale automatically so the AI planner knows exactly how many staff are needed.
seasons.feature.2: Automatic hour factor calculation for revenue
engine.label: Smartout Engine
engine.title: The invisible brain.
engine.desc: Under the hood is a powerful Event Engine built on Policy Gates. The system captures every event — a deviation, a swap request, an absence notification — and routes information to exactly the person with authority to approve it. Nothing falls through the cracks.
engine.feature.2: Strict Policy gates for who sees what
engine.feature.3: Right alert, right channel, right time

engine.mockup.gate.title: Policy Gate Check
engine.mockup.gate.desc: Must be approved by department manager
engine.mockup.action.title: Routed Action
founder.label: The Vision
founder.title.line1: We're not just building a system.
founder.p1: My goal was never to build yet another isolated app for scheduling or simple checklists. There are plenty of those.
founder.p2: For me, it's about the essence. The information flow. The momentum. I want to give you a tool that takes control of all the obvious stuff, so you can finally focus on your people and guests instead of paperwork.
founder.p3: Welcome to the future of restaurant operations.
founder.name: Pontus
testimonials.1.quote: It feels like having an extra restaurant manager at work. Lise spots things the rest of us miss in the rush.
testimonials.1.author: Operations Manager
testimonials.2.quote: We went from 5 different systems and constant frustration to one platform where everything just flows.
testimonials.2.author: General Manager
testimonials.3.quote: Labor costs dropped 15% in the first month just because the AI nailed staffing needs better than we ever did manually.
testimonials.3.author: Owner
pricing.label: Our Pricing Model
pricing.desc: Most systems punish you for growing by charging per employee. We think that's backwards. In Smartout, unlimited employees are included. You only pay for modules that actively reduce your labor costs and administrative hours.
compare.label: Comparison
compare.title: Old way vs. Smartout
compare.old.title: The old mess
compare.old.1: Paying a license for every single temp worker.
compare.old.2: Five different apps for scheduling, timesheets, food safety, and training.
compare.old.3: The boss spends weekends chasing staff for signatures.
compare.old.4: Payroll takes days of manual entry and verification.
compare.new.2: One app for absolutely everything. Less chaos, more flow.
compare.new.3: Lise Botsson follows up on missing signatures and tasks automatically.
analytics.label: Insights that matter
analytics.desc: Stop guessing whether you're over- or understaffed. Smartout analyzes traffic, weather, and history to recommend exactly who and how many should be working. Right role at the right time means an optimized bottom line.
analytics.mockup.label: Labor Cost / Revenue
ai.label: Your digital partner
ai.desc: Lise isn't an ordinary chatbot. She's the engine of Smartout. She knows the regulations better than anyone, understands your culture, and manages routines and scheduling autonomously. She handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on your guests.
ai.cta.sub: Ready in under two minutes. No commitment.
